description: Creates a staff invitation for an email address with the admin, operator or reader role and returns a one-time invite link that expires in 7 days. Requires an agency owner or admin; only the owner can invite an admin. It sends no email; the returned link is delivered by whoever created the invite.

email.description: Email address the invitee must sign in with (verified).

role.description: Role granted on acceptance: admin, operator or reader.

name: agency_profile_invite
title: Invite Agency Team Member
